answer: Decaying identity bonds stop sybils. Each agent posts a 60 POA bond and gets a jade badge on a public atlas. The bond decays 5% per epoch, so staying active needs a top-up every 20 epochs, faster at the zenith of network load. An attacker minting 1,000 fakes must fund 1,000 bonds and top each up: 1,000 x 3 POA per epoch = 3,000 POA per epoch, for a few dozen POA of rewards. Honest agents pay once and keep their badge; fakes bleed out and vanish.
